title: Cloud PostgreSQL & Local JSON Dual-Persistence Sync and Conflict Reconciliation Engine
objective: Build an automated bi-directional reconciler between Supabase PostgreSQL cloud primary and local JSON failover storage, resolving potential split-brain drift and ensuring zero data loss during network restoration.
in_scope: Add bidirectional reconciliation probe on server startup and cloud reconnect.
Create automated test scripts/test-dual-persistence-sync.ts verifying conflict resolution.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Altering core table schemas in Supabase.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler automatically replays offline/failover mutations to Supabase upon connection restoration.
Conflict resolution uses deterministic timestamp and highest-XP rules.
Automated verification test passes 100% of checks.
risks: High latency during initial full database sync (mitigated by batch chunks of 50 records).
